newsitem.title: GERMANY: German metal employers warn of job losses.
newsitem.headline: German metal employers warn of job losses.

text.p: A leading representative of German employers in the metalworking and electronics industries on Monday warned that between 120,000 and 130,000 jobs would be lost in those sectors this year.
Dieter Hundt, vice-president of the Gesamtmetall employers group, told German radio that industry conditions at the moment were "particularly fraught".

Speaking before an emergency meeting between Gesamtmetall and the IG Metall trade union on a controversial new law cutting sick payments to workers, Hundt said he was entering the discussions with "great expectations and optimism".
He urged worker groups to end protest actions which last included walk-outs by more than 100,000 metal workers across the country.
The metal and electronics sectors in Germany employ around 3.5 million people.
